text:
Ava: dropped a new mock — trying a 'waveform' strip instead of a traditional rug under the p95 chart to show density + outlier spikes together. figma: https://www.figma.com/file/wave123/p95-waveform (screenshot)
Connor: love the waveform idea. first pass feedback: 1) waveform fills can confuse color semantics with heatmap, 2) the selection handles are pretty small on tablet. can we keep color mapping consistent with the heatmap legend? :mag_right:
Riley: for sampling controls, what if we show a micro-dropdown on hover: [Auto sample: 1s | 5s | 10s | adaptive]? that makes it discoverable but not noisy.
Jess: accessibility nits: 1) waveform fill contrast fails at small sizes; suggest toggling outlines for low-contrast modes, 2) selection handles need a 12px min hit area and visible focus styles, 3) ensure waveform is announced as "density overview" for screen readers (not just decorative).
Noah: implementation note: waveform + heatmap overlap can be expensive. we should prerender the waveform into an offscreen canvas and composite. sampling dropdown can be a simple select with aria-label.
Ava: copy idea for the tooltip when hovering a spike: current: "p95: 240ms @ 11:42" proposed: "p95 240ms — 11:42" (shorter). for selection summary: "Range 812m  p95: 240ms" — aim for compactness.
Connor: small UX flow: user drags selection -> temporary preview applies to the main chart -> a toast appears: "Previewing range (press Enter to pin)" -> if user presses Enter we pin. avoids accidental changes.
Riley: sampling UX: show a micro badge on the minimap: "Adaptive sampling" with a small info icon. clicking opens help: "Adaptive sampling increases sampling interval for quieter periods to save cost." we should link to docs.
Jess: keyboard interactions: handles should support Home/End to snap to full range, PageUp/PageDown to expand/shrink by 10%, Arrow keys to nudge 1%. also announce range delta after each key action via aria-live polite.
Noah: engineering: if we animate previews, keep animation <200ms and cancel if new input arrives. for the sampling control keep state machine simple: {mode: auto|manual, interval: number, pinned: bool} and persist in URL when pinned.
Ava: accessibility copy tweak: change toast text to "Range preview (press Enter to pin selection)" so it's clear. also add screen-reader-only text after pin: "Selection pinned at 820m to 1220m".
Connor: question about mobile: do we collapse the waveform into a single-line spark and show a dedicated 'expand' button? mobile handles are fiddly.
Riley: yes, collapse on <360px and show an expand chevron. touch target should be 44px min for the expand control.
Jess: final checklist for the mock update: stronger waveform contrast, 12px hit targets, focus ring variant for high-contrast, tooltip copy shortened, toast language updated, keyboard shortcut doc snippet, sampling dropdown microcopy, mobile collapse behavior.
Ava: awesome. I'll iterate and post new figma by tomorrow morning. tagging @Riley @Noah for canvas implementation check once I share. thanks team :raised_hands:
